verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents an official, hosted MCP server with separate sandbox and production endpoints, OAuth sign-in against the Dashboard account, and a Claude Code setup command. Its documented tools cover knowledge-base search, guided onboarding, and payment operations: querying statuses, refunds, voids, and payment links. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works in practice, and general-availability status (it is currently labeled Beta).
